style: Cute collectible trading card game illustration in a polished chibi storybook cartoon style: bold clean outlines, soft cel shading, vibrant saturated colours, big expressive sparkly eyes, warm and friendly mood. One clear main subject, centred and fully in frame, with a softly painted background scene. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, symbols, logos, borders, card frames or watermarks.

families.Citrus: Background: a sunny Mediterranean citrus grove with lemon and orange trees, warm yellow and orange light.
families.Orchard: Background: a cosy autumn apple orchard with golden afternoon light, warm reds, greens and browns.
families.Garden: Background: a fresh cottage vegetable garden with leafy greens, flowers and morning light.
families.Berry: Background: a lush berry patch full of strawberries and raspberries, pinks, reds and purples.
families.Tropical: Background: a tropical jungle clearing with palm leaves, mangoes and a golden sunset.
families.Melon: Background: a lazy summer melon patch with big striped watermelons, soft greens and pinks.
